Random pools of cells within groups

Source: R/caller.R
make_pools.Rd

Shuffles the cells of each group (cell type) and splits them into round(n / n_pool) pools of (nearly) equal size; groups with fewer than ceiling(n_pool / 2) cells give no pool.

Usage

make_pools(cells, group = NULL, n_pool = 20, seed = 1)

Arguments

cells

cell ids

group

group per cell (NULL = one group)

n_pool

target pool size

seed

RNG seed

Value

data.table pool, cell, group
